cases.purpose: dmsetup create/remove (default, --noudevsync) return only once /dev/mapper/NAME exists or is gone, with the same status, messages and node state as GNU dmsetup when no udev daemon runs.
cases.oracle: GNU/libdevmapper dmsetup against the same loop-backed linear device (udev either not running, or started by the fixture and stopped and verified gone at the end); loop names normalised.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and file tree.
cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
export BASHOS_DMSETUP_ALLOW_MUTATE=1
trap '/usr/sbin/dmsetup --noudevsync remove_all >/dev/null 2>&1; cleanup' EXIT
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >o.txt 2>e.txt; local rc=$?; printf '[%s] status=%s\n' "$l" $rc; norm o.txt; echo "[stderr]"; norm e.txt; }
ex() { if [[ -e /dev/mapper/$1 ]]; then echo "  $1 node-present"; else echo "  $1 node-absent"; fi; }
/usr/bin/truncate -s 2M a.img; at a.img; A=$REPLY; reg $A LOOP-A
S=$(/usr/sbin/blockdev --getsz $A)
r create-noudevsync dmsetup create --noudevsync w7nosync --table "0 $S linear $A 0"; ex w7nosync
r info-after-create dmsetup info -c --noheadings -o name,attr w7nosync
r remove-noudevsync dmsetup remove --noudevsync w7nosync; ex w7nosync
r create-addnodeonresume dmsetup create --noudevsync --addnodeoncreate w7node --table "0 $S linear $A 0"; ex w7node
r remove-force dmsetup remove --noudevsync -f w7node; ex w7node

cases.purpose: With a udev daemon running, create and remove wait on a udev cookie so the node exists/disappears when the command returns (default sync), while --noudevsync returns without waiting, matching GNU dmsetup.
cases.oracle: GNU/libdevmapper dmsetup against the same loop-backed linear device (udev either not running, or started by the fixture and stopped and verified gone at the end); loop names normalised.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and file tree.
cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
export BASHOS_DMSETUP_ALLOW_MUTATE=1
trap '/usr/sbin/dmsetup --noudevsync remove_all >/dev/null 2>&1; cleanup' EXIT
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >o.txt 2>e.txt; local rc=$?; printf '[%s] status=%s\n' "$l" $rc; norm o.txt; echo "[stderr]"; norm e.txt; }
ex() { if [[ -e /dev/mapper/$1 ]]; then echo "  $1 node-present"; else echo "  $1 node-absent"; fi; }
/usr/bin/truncate -s 2M a.img; at a.img; A=$REPLY; reg $A LOOP-A
S=$(/usr/sbin/blockdev --getsz $A)
UD=/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-udevd
[[ -x $UD ]] || UD=/lib/systemd/systemd-udevd
$UD --daemon 2>/dev/null; for i in {1..50}; do /usr/bin/udevadm control --ping 2>/dev/null && break; read -t 0.1 -r _ <> <(:) || :; done
echo "udevd-ping=$(/usr/bin/udevadm control --ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ok || echo failed)"
stop_udev() { /usr/bin/udevadm control --exit 2>/dev/null; for i in {1..100}; do /usr/bin/pgrep -x systemd-udevd >/dev/null || break; read -t 0.1 -r _ <> <(:) || :; done; }
trap 'stop_udev; /usr/sbin/dmsetup --noudevsync remove_all >/dev/null 2>&1; cleanup' EXIT
r create-udev-sync dmsetup create w7udev --table "0 $S linear $A 0"; ex w7udev
r symlink-resolves dmsetup info -c --noheadings -o name w7udev
r remove-udev-sync dmsetup remove w7udev; ex w7udev
r create-noudevsync dmsetup create --noudevsync w7udev2 --table "0 $S linear $A 0"
/usr/bin/udevadm settle -t 10 2>/dev/null; ex w7udev2
r remove-noudevsync dmsetup remove --noudevsync w7udev2
/usr/bin/udevadm settle -t 10 2>/dev/null; ex w7udev2

cases.purpose: Node ownership options (-U/-G/-M) on a libdevmapper-created node and the report options (-o, -c, --noheadings, --separator, --select, --sort) produce the same node uid/gid/mode and the same report text as GNU dmsetup.
cases.oracle: GNU/libdevmapper dmsetup against the same loop-backed linear device (udev either not running, or started by the fixture and stopped and verified gone at the end); loop names normalised.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and file tree.
cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
export BASHOS_DMSETUP_ALLOW_MUTATE=1
trap '/usr/sbin/dmsetup --noudevsync remove_all >/dev/null 2>&1; cleanup' EXIT
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >o.txt 2>e.txt; local rc=$?; printf '[%s] status=%s\n' "$l" $rc; norm o.txt; echo "[stderr]"; norm e.txt; }
ex() { if [[ -e /dev/mapper/$1 ]]; then echo "  $1 node-present"; else echo "  $1 node-absent"; fi; }
/usr/bin/truncate -s 2M a.img; at a.img; A=$REPLY; reg $A LOOP-A
S=$(/usr/sbin/blockdev --getsz $A)
r create-owned dmsetup create --noudevsync w7own -U 2000 -G 2000 -M 0640 --table "0 $S linear $A 0"
echo "node ownership: $(/usr/bin/stat -L -c '%u %g %a' /dev/mapper/w7own 2>&1)"
r info-columns dmsetup info -c -o name,attr,open,segments w7own
r info-noheadings dmsetup info -c --noheadings -o name,attr w7own
r info-separator dmsetup info -c --noheadings --separator : -o name,attr,open w7own
r info-select dmsetup info -c --noheadings -o name --select name=w7own
r info-select-miss dmsetup info -c --noheadings -o name --select name=nosuch
r table-columns dmsetup table w7own
r status dmsetup status w7own
r ls-tree dmsetup ls --tree
r info-sort dmsetup info -c --noheadings -o name --sort name
r info-sort-desc dmsetup info -c --noheadings -o name --sort -name
r info-bad-field dmsetup info -c -o nosuchfield w7own
r info-uuid-field dmsetup info -c --noheadings -o name,uuid w7own
